text: The market will be harder in 2028 than it is now.
I am going to professionalize the company either way.
By 2029 I will have handed the site work to somebody else.
I am applying in October, and the interviews are due to start that month.
The program is how I bridge the gap between what I run and what I was trained for.
I could see the ceiling before I hit it, and that is why I am applying now.

I can tell you in two paragraphs whether somebody has a plan or a wish, and it is not the ambition that gives it away, it is the verbs. An essay written entirely in will is a wish with a date on it. Here is the test I apply to the first goal on every page, and it is not a kind one. Would this still happen if we did not admit you? If nothing on the page survives that question, then the program is being used as the plan, and a program is not a plan. Now, about the long-term goal at the end. Nobody on this side of the table expects it to come true. We are not reading a prediction and marking it right or wrong five years later. What we are reading is whether you can build a road map that connects that goal to something you are doing on Monday morning. If the two ends do not meet, the middle is where you lost us.

I went back and read my own goals essay about a month ago, two years after I wrote it. The long-term goal did not happen. It was never going to happen, and here is the strange part: nobody has ever asked me about it since, not once, not in any conversation. What did matter was the boring paragraph in the middle, the first-year deliverable, which was writing our pricing process down. It was incremental and it was dull and it is the thing that changed the company, because it took the decision out of my head and put it somewhere twenty-five people could see it. If I wrote the essay again today I would put fewer wills in it. I wrote about a future I was predicting, when what the reader wanted was the two or three things I had already decided, with the dates I had already agreed to.
I am applying in October, and the interviews are due to start that month.
I am going to professionalize the company either way.
By 2029 I will have handed the site work to somebody else.
The market will be harder in 2028 than it is now.
When I finish the program, I will be forty-nine.
The program is how I bridge the gap between what I run and what I was trained for.
I could see the ceiling before I hit it, and that is why I am applying now.
